english.title: Fail to give local authority 48 hours notice before disconnection and sealing of drains
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to give at least 48 hours notice to **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..) before complying with a requirement under section 62 of the Building Act 1984 to cause drains or parts of drains becoming disused or unnecessary to be disconnected and sealed at the required points
english.legislation: Contrary to section 62(4) of the Building Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
fail to give local authority
48 hours notice
before disconnecting / sealing disused or unnecessary drains

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This section does not apply in relation to anything done in the course of the demolition of a building, or part of a building, being a demolition as respects which the local authority have power under section 81 to serve a notice on the person undertaking the demolition. - section 62(6)
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant failed to give at least 48 hours notice to **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..) before complying with a requirement under section 62 of the Building Act 1984 to cause drains or parts of drains becoming disused or unnecessary to be disconnected and sealed at the required points.
